other.tags: Synthwave. Analog polyphonic synthesizers play sustained minor chords with a slow filter sweep. A monophonic sawtooth bassline executes a steady sixteenth-note ostinato. The drum machine utilizes gated reverb on the snare and a compressed kick drum. A lead synth with high resonance and portamento plays a melodic theme in the upper register. 110 BPM. Key of B minor. 4/4 time signature. Sidechain compression causes the pads to pump in synchronization with the kick drum. A digital delay effect is applied to the lead synth with a dotted-eighth-note feedback loop.

bass.tags: Funk-rock fusion with heavy slap bass and syncopated percussion. The arrangement features a prominent electric bass performing rapid thumb-slaps and finger-pops in a 16th-note rhythmic pattern. A dry, tight drum kit utilizes a crisp snare and high-pitched, open hi-hat accents. Clean-toned electric guitar provides rhythmic stabs on the off-beats. A distorted lead guitar enters with sustained vibrato and blues-based pentatonic runs. The tempo is 115 BPM in the key of E minor. The mix is dry with minimal reverb, emphasizing the percussive transients of the bass and drums.

A clean, mid-range electric bass guitar follows the kick drum pattern with short, plucked notes. 110 BPM. 4/4 time signature.
